It looks like you are calling dat in random places in your code so before it got assigned a value, it is trying to print it, thus that random error. The app still "works" as you have described.

I believe the problem is in output$choose_columns <- renderUI({
In here is the only place in your code with dat <<- and every where else you just have dat <-. So your data set only gets refreshed in this part of your code. There also seems to be other random bugs that happen periodically, but I can't seem to reproduce them consistently.
